**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.4 is the fourth release candidate.** It brings more cars' hook maps, fixes for uninstall and the vehicle service, and wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-rc.5. 1.1.0 will be this code unless a blocker turns up. **This RC hasn't been checked on a car yet**, so please report how it goes. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release.

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.5](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.5)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**. NEMESIS in the app menu is the same as in rc.3.

## What's new since 1.1.0-rc.3

- **More cars' hook maps**, all with every hook point:

  | Region | Cars |
  |---|---|
  | USA | Ioniq 6 on 260507; Elantra (`CN7PE`) on 260507; Elantra N 2024 and Kona (`OSPE`) on 260903; the Ioniq 5 `NEEV23SE` on 260903 |
  | Canada | Niro EV (`SG225EV`) on 260206; the Ioniq 5 on 260903 (same software as the US Ioniq 5 2023) |

- **Maps completed or corrected:**
  - **Ioniq 6 on 260903, USA and Canada:** all 351 points, and checked on a car, so its hooks run without "Try unchecked maps".
  - **The Korean Hyundai build** (Sonata, Santa Fe, Palisade) and **Genesis G70 Canada:** all 351 points, from rc.3 Car Reports.
  - **Ioniq 6 Singapore:** 312 points, up from 305.
  - **The newer Kia build in Canada** (Niro, Sportage, Carnival, Telluride, Forte, Soul, Seltos 2024): its Phone Projection points. Before, wireless CarPlay + Android Auto's hooks stayed off there.
  - Six more maps rebuilt from their builds' stock files.
- **Uninstall works when a mod's file is gone.** If something else deleted a file a mod had added (an old package's uninstall did this to the wireless mod's audio library), uninstall and Apply both stopped with "changed outside HMG-API". The file wasn't there before HMG-API added it, so missing now counts as stock: uninstall goes through, and Apply puts the file back (#226). `engine apply --force` now also writes back owned files that were deleted or changed outside HMG-API, as its hint said it would (#103).
- **The vehicle service across drives** (thanks to lemoyneiv). With QuickBoot it lives from one drive to the next, so a dismissed startup notice or a battery-conditioning timeout from one drive blocked the next. Waking from suspend or switching off now resets them (#269). Routed battery conditioning for a charger far away now waits until the car is 18 minutes out before it can time out (#270). There are also socket and speed-reading fixes (#271).
- **The outside temperature no longer reads -40** right after the car wakes (thanks to zpoon, #180).
- **Two more mods in the catalogue:** CarPlay Keys (DeFlight, LLC) and Comfort & Startup (lemoyneiv).
- **Wireless 2.2.0-rc.5** brings:
  - the Ioniq 6 on US 260507 and 260903 and Canada 260903, the Ioniq 5 `NEEV23SE`, the Sportage Hybrid and the Elantra N;
  - a setting to let CarPlay through the hotspot firewall on cars that block it;
  - Now Playing on wireless CarPlay;
  - CarPlay's turns in the car's own format for the AR HUD.

  See [its notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.5).
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.4/CHANGELOG.md).

## Car Reports wanted

These builds' maps were made before HMG-API checked the code behind each hook point, so a few of their points are still matched by name only. **One Car Report from this RC per row confirms them**, for every model in the row:

| Build | Any one of these |
|---|---|
| Hyundai Ioniq 6, Canada 260206 | Ioniq 6 |
| Hyundai Palisade, US 260903 | Palisade 2023 and on |
| Genesis G70 | USA 260507 or Korea 260902 |
| Kia, Korea 260902 | EV6, K3 |
| Hyundai Creta, India 260430 | Creta |

These have **no map yet**, and a Car Report from this RC is all it takes to make one: the **Palisade on US 260507**, the **Kona Electric on Canada 260206** and the **Avante (Elantra) in Korea**.

A **Check the map on this car** (HMG-API app → Settings) helps too, from any car whose map says "waiting for a check on a car": one check per build lets that build's map run without "Try unchecked maps". More in [#247](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/247).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta or an earlier RC:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.4-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Restart the head unit once afterwards. Your mods and settings stay. To update the wireless mod too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.5.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, pick it in Check USB updates, and **Apply changes**.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.4-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** follow [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.4-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- **After updating:** the app shows **1.1.0-rc.4** and "Hooks on" on a car that had them, and your mods still run after a restart.
- **Uninstall and install again** (without `PURGE`): the head unit starts normally afterwards, and NEMESIS still starts.
- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto** on a car where they worked with rc.3: music, a call, turn-by-turn on the cluster.
- **A car in the new list:** HMG-API app → Settings → **Check the map on this car**, restart, then make a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report).
- **Two drives in a row with QuickBoot** (switch off and back on without the head unit restarting): mods that dismiss the startup notice or start battery conditioning still work on the second drive.

## Known issues

- Bluetooth Audio can take audio focus at a cold start before CarPlay or Android Auto is up. A fix is in review (wireless #56).
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting, so take the stick out after installing.

## Going back

- **To 1.1.0-rc.3 with adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **To 1.0.2:** as in [rc.3's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.3#going-back-to-102). Wireless 2.2.0-rc.5 needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer, so going back to 1.0.2 means going back to wireless 2.1.0 too.

## Reporting

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with your car, its head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version and your mods, and a Car Report if you can.
